companyOverview: Started as a workshop supplying local retailers. Now exports finished leather goods to Kenya and Djibouti while serving hotels in Addis.
motivation: Need coaching and a splitting machine to raise quality and hire operators.
businessGoals: Double export volume by 2027 and add a finishing line in Addis.
marketOverview: Domestic hotels and two East African buyers. Main challenge is finishing quality versus imported goods.

products.distributionChannels: Direct B2B and one distributor in Kenya

uniqueFeatures: Vegetable-tanned hides sourced from Modjo with a patented edge-paint finish.
keyRawMaterials: Ethiopian cattle hides, local cotton lining, vegetable tannins
problemsToAddress: Inconsistent finishing quality, limited splitting capacity, and weak export documentation.

consultantRequests.problemDescription: Export documentation and rules of origin

priorityAreasExplanation: The splitter and finishing expert raise quality; the trade advisor opens Kenya volume.
jobCreationNarrative: We will create 21 new jobs in the next 15 months: operators on the new line, two quality controllers, and sales for export.
socialEnvironmentalImpact: Chrome-free tanning waste is collected; 40% of shop-floor staff are women from the woreda.
oshCommitment: PPE at every station, first-aid kit, monthly risk assessment, and paid sick leave.
